items.t: Sponsored legislation funding supportive housing development in Nevada.
items.q: revising provisions relating to the Nevada Supportive Housing Development Fund; making an appropriation

record.t: Sponsored Assembly Bill 366 (2025), revising the Nevada Supportive Housing Development Fund and making an appropriation; it was enrolled.
Beat incumbent Judith Whitmer by a margin of 314-99 in the state party chair election.
record.q: Assemblywoman Daniele Monroe-Moreno (D) beat out embattled incumbent Judith Whitmer by a margin of 314-99 in the state party chair election on Saturday.

record.t: Chaired the Assembly Ways and Means Committee (2021–2026), after serving as vice chair in 2019–2020.
Defeated Howard Brean in the 2016 general election for Nevada Assembly District 1.
record.q: Daniele Monroe-Moreno defeated Howard Brean in the Nevada State Assembly District 1 general election.

record.t: Served in the Nevada State Assembly, District 1, from 2016 to 2026.

record.t: Is chair of the Democratic Party of Nevada.
